purpose: Create forward-only, append-only evidence for announcement availability without pretending reconstructed archives were observed historically
scope: Official CNINFO announcement metadata and returned document identities observed after protocol freeze; no prices, returns, labels, model training or broker access

separation.prospective_ledger: Only records actually first observed after V5 freeze may receive prospective_first_seen timestamps

rules: Append immutable raw-response hash, query window, retrieval start/end, source publication timestamp and document identity
Never backdate first_seen from source publication date
Duplicate ids must preserve the first observed hash and record later hash changes as new evidence, never overwrite
Correction/supplement/cancellation/withdrawal titles stay quarantined until an explicit parent id is available or a separately frozen lineage rule is validated
Use next trading session after max(source publication day, actual Shanghai first-seen day) as the earliest prospective effective date
No document body is approved by metadata observation alone
acceptance: Tests prove append-only behavior, idempotency, hash-change detection, timezone handling and no backdating
Writes are confined to a new data/announcement_first_seen_v5 directory and its artifact receipts
At least one genuinely new post-freeze official announcement is observed before prospective_pit_verified can become true
Historical PIT remains false for all reconstructed pre-freeze rows
